definition: AD Model Builder is a framework that uses automatic differentiation to fit complex statistical models by numerical optimization.
entry_text: AD Model Builder is a framework that uses automatic differentiation to fit complex statistical models by numerical optimization.
example: A fisheries scientist fits a population model and evaluates uncertainty in its fitted parameters.
label: AD Model Builder

sources.note: The project connects automatic differentiation to nonlinear statistical modeling and optimization and describes ADMB as a statistical application implementing automatic differentiation.
